replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset while retaining as much variability as possible. The basic idea is to find the directions (principal components) in which the data varies the most. You can perform PCA by first standardizing your data.
